title: Detect flow-collection values as unresolved at open time, before container-stack operations lose visibility
context: A multi-line flow-style YAML selector (`selector: {app: web,` on one line, `tier: web` on the next) was silently losing the opening-line key (`app`) — the Service's selector became overly permissive, false-matching Deployments with different apps but the same tier.
decision: When a value opens a flow collection ({/[), immediately mark that path as unresolved before any closing-line container-pop operations remove visibility. This prevents the scanner from producing an incomplete, partially-seen map as if it were resolved.
consequences: Flow-collection values are always detected as unresolved, never silently partial
Selector/label mismatches no longer produce false-positive edges for objects with mismatched opening-line keys
Fixes a fundamental limitation of line-oriented YAML scanning: keys on the opening line of a multi-line container are now accounted for
alternatives_rejected: Extract and track keys from opening lines within the line-oriented scan (adds complexity without solving the general visibility problem)
Rely on container-pop timing to detect unresolved containers (loses visibility before opening-line keys can be marked)
